title: Nonlinear metric stability from geodesic stretch on exact hyperbolic cusp manifolds

standard_prerequisites.use: Standard prior results stay cited; complete source-local proofs and definitions retained.

core_obligations: The author develops an anisotropic Holder-Zygmund flow resolvent compatible with decaying cusp perturbations and invertible tensor normal operators. Solenoidal gauge fixing and a nonlinear geodesic-stretch expansion then yield the original weighted stability estimate modulo diffeomorphisms, with marked-length rigidity as a direct consequence.
